name: quantset
description: Query 52,000+ global stocks (67 countries, 64yr US history), 734 crypto pairs, 40-factor stock screens, Wall Street consensus estimates, ETF look-through weights, multi-asset correlations, Treasury/TIPS curves, and reconciled financials.

interface.longDescription: Analyze 52,000+ global equities across 67 countries (US history to 1962), 734 crypto pairs, 42 FX currencies, hourly bars, 40+ factor stock screens, Wall Street EPS/revenue estimates, 4,899 ETF look-through holdings, multi-asset correlations, U.S. Treasury/TIPS yield curves, 82 FRED macro series, and reconciled company financials. Read-only reference data with explicit source provenance; does not execute trades or provide investment advice.
capabilities: Global stock, ETF & crypto quotes and 64-year price history
40-factor equity screening, peer valuation & drawdown math
Wall Street consensus estimates, ratings & earnings surprises
ETF look-through weights, Treasury curves & FRED macro series
Reconciled company financials, revenue segments & ownership
defaultPrompt: Compare NVDA, AAPL, and BTCUSDT trailing returns and valuation.
What are Wall Street consensus EPS estimates for MSFT?
Show the current U.S. Treasury yield curve from 1M to 30Y.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with 14 read-only market, quant, consensus, ETF, macro, and company-research tools.
